The vendor directly providing the **Figma** software platform at **figma.com** is **Figma, Inc.**.

### Supporting Evidence & Provider Statement
* In Figma's legal disclosures and regulatory filings regarding the service at `figma.com`, the company specifies: 
  > *"Unless otherwise indicated, the terms 'Figma,' the 'company,' 'we,' 'us,' and 'our' refer to Figma, Inc. and our subsidiaries... We have an automated and highly efficient self-service option, available through Figma.com."*
* Figma's official privacy and legal terms (`figma.com/legal/privacy/`) state:
  > *"Figma, Inc. (for the purposes of this section, 'Figma', 'we', or 'us')..."*
* Official store listings (e.g., Chrome Web Store) identify the developer and provider of Figma tools as **Figma, Inc.** (located in San Francisco, CA).
